rework.whiteBandedVolume: The cream/white stacked-band volume with cantilevered stone slab edges and deep glazed strips in ref-southwest.jpg (right half) and ref-southwest-far.jpg is NOT this pand: it is a neighbour, the 2026 pand 0363100012247366 centred about 63 m west / 61 m south of this pand (PDOK BAG). Evidence: camera-matched geometry (artifacts/landmark-lanes/bercylaan-801-855/contact-far.png) puts this pand 50-90 m east of the camera behind that building; the black grid block and the grey panel block left of it are this pand (27 m shoulder and 8 m block).
